---
title: "Exercise 3.6"
---

## Solution

First, we have $\nu(\emptyset) = \mu(\emptyset \cap B) = \mu(\emptyset) = 0$.

Next, let $\{A_i\}$ be a pairwise disjoint sequence of sets in $\mathcal A$. Then
$$\nu \left( \bigcup_i A_i \right) = \mu \left( \left(\bigcup_i A_i \right) \cap B\right)
= \mu \left( \bigcup_i (A_i \cap B) \right) = \sum_i \mu(A_i \cap B) = \sum_i \nu(A_i).$$

Hence $\nu$ is countably additive, and therefore a measure.
